output.headline: Top-ranked buyer: all three of its deals are in the target's own Health IT sub-sector, and it pays near the comparable median.
output.differentiator: Every one of its deals is in the target's own sub-sector and all closed (3 of 3), at a 21.6x median paid, above the sponsor bidders on the priority list.
output.why_them: Same-sub-sector Health IT add-on; pays near the comparable median

acquirer_overview.title: Independent public Health IT operator with a fully closed record
points: Independent public company (NYSE EVH) with annual revenue of $1,876M (fiscal year ending 2025-12-31) [P:1, P:2].
Three deals between 2018 and 2022, all closed (3 of 3, 100%), all in Health IT, one of them a minority stake [T:record, K:closed_share].
Board refreshed under a cooperation agreement with activist Engaged Capital; accountable care business sold to Privia Health, closed 2025-12-05 [P:1, P:5].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: The target sits squarely in the sub-sector where Evolent buys
points: Share of deals in the target's sub-sector is the strongest factor; margin close to what it usually buys is a strong factor [S:sector_share, S:margin_fit].
Technology Capability motive in 3 of 3 deals, against 10% of all deals in the file; Margin Improvement also in 3 of 3 [M:technology_capability, M:margin_improvement].
10-K says it may buy companies that "complement our current products and services, enhance our market coverage or technical capabilities" [P:3].

precedent_activity.title: Three Health IT deals, all closed, led by a $325M recapitalization
points: Frontier Health AI: $325M recapitalization, 2022, 19.8x EBITDA and 6.66x revenue [D:MA-2022-0353].
Eastern EHR Solutions: $31M strategic acquisition, 2022, 22.4x [D:MA-2022-0458]. Southwest EHR Solutions: $37M minority investment, 2018, 21.6x [D:MA-2018-0149].
Only 1 of 3 deals falls in the $150M-$600M comparable size band [K:size_band].

valuation_context.title: Median multiple is the defensible anchor, and Evolent already pays there
points: 13 comparable same-sub-sector deals run from 19.4x to 23.3x EV/EBITDA, with a median of 21.4x [V:comps].
Target margin of 25.0% is above the comps' median of 22.2% but not in their top quarter, so the 50th percentile is defensible [V:comps].
Evolent's own median paid is 21.6x; cost synergies give headroom of $14M-$23M, set against $1,876M of revenue [V:comps, V:synergy, P:2].

risk_flags.title: Size stretch
risk_flags.concern: Median deal is $37M, and only 1 of 3 deals sits in the comparable size band.
risk_flags.mitigant: Frontier Health AI at $325M in 2022 shows it can write a cheque this size.
risk_flags.reality: Its biggest deal is $325M, close to the target's $300M, but it is a single precedent [T:record, K:size_band, D:MA-2022-0353].

risk_flags.title: Quiet since 2022
risk_flags.concern: Deals in recent years is a slight factor against, and it has no deal in the target's region.
risk_flags.mitigant: Its 10-K keeps acquisitions open, and its 8-Ks show no merger agreement since 2025.
risk_flags.reality: Two deals since 2022; the activist-driven board refresh may temper appetite [S:recency, K:recent, T:record, P:1, P:3].

risk_flags.title: Competitive process
risk_flags.concern: The priority list includes open-platform sponsors and strategics such as Privia Health.
risk_flags.mitigant: As a strategic owner it can pay on cost synergies, with headroom of $14M-$23M.
risk_flags.reality: Ranked first on the priority list of 10, at a likelihood of 5.6% across 107 buyers scored [R:rank, V:synergy].

conviction.rationale: Three deals in the target's own sub-sector and the number one position on the priority list support High; having no deal in the target's region is neutral [C:conviction, T:record, R:rank].
